lines.en: I knock on the door and wait a moment to see if anyone responds.
Well, to see if Sana responds.
If anyone other than her or Ayane answered, I'd probably just leave.
Either way, no one does- but I’m suddenly compelled to knock again for reasons beyond my comprehension.
: Hello? Is anyone in there?
: Sensei?...
: Yup. Just dropping by to see how you're doing.
: You're...
: Dropping by...my room?...
I guess I'm going to have to speak to Sana through the door until I can convince her to allow me inside of her room.
: Is that weird?
: I don't...think it's normal for...teachers to come to their students' rooms...
: Well, I'm here. So I guess this just means either I leave or we hang out.
: The choice is in your hands.
: Uhh...
: I'll understand if you don't want to, Sana. It's fine.
: I...I didn’t say that, but...
: If it makes you feel any better, I'm doing this for educational purposes.
: What...sort of educational purposes...would that even-
: It's part of that new strategy I was talking about in class. The one where we need to start being friendlier and less formal.
: I don't know, Sensei...This still seems really weird...
: I don't think so. It's just a totally normal and socially acceptable after-school self-invitation.
: So, can I come in?
: I'm...starting to think you won't go away even if I say no...
: That's a fair assumption.
I hear the sound of the door unlocking and take that as my cue to make my way inside.
: G...Good evening...
: Thanks for letting me in. I get that it probably feels a little weird.
: It's...more than just...a little...
: But...um...here we are...
: The place I...live...
: I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume your side is on the right?
: Umm...yeah...If you’re looking at it...from your direction...
: If you...look at it from mine it’s...it's on the...left...
: Thank you for explaining how directions work, Sana. I had forgotten.
: You're...
: You're welcome...
This is even more awkward than I thought it would be.
: I'm going to go out on a second limb here and assume you’ve also never been alone with a guy before, have you?
: R-Right...
: But you’re just my teacher so...I don’t...really look at you that way...
: You don’t...view me as a male?
: Oh! N-No! That’s not what I meant! I obviously...know you're...uhh...It’s just that...umm...
: Hah...
: This is just...kind of embarrassing for me, so...
: I'm probably going to...say a lot of things that are...um..........bad.
: Noted.
Sana’s half of the dorm is more or less what I expected.
The only thing I'd say is different from my imagination is the lack of black, but I guess all the spider stickers make up for that.
Apart from that, everything seems mostly normal.
Bed? Check. Video game stuff? Check. Creepy stuffed animal facing the ceiling? Another check.
Considering that only one of those three things is worth talking about, though, I pretty much know where to move the conversation next.
: I didn’t know you were into games, Sana.
: Oh! Y...Yes!
: I don’t...really go out much, so...
: I sort of...play games to pass the time...
: Well, maybe we could play something together sometime? That might be a decent way to get to know each other.
: You...play games, Sensei? You don’t think you’re...too old for that?
: There’s no such thing as being ‘too old’ for video games, Sana. That's a myth.
: Also, don’t call me old.
: Oh, I...I didn't mean it like that...I’m sorry...
: It’s just that...my mom is always telling me I should go out more, and...umm...experience the world, I think she said?...
: Which...isn't really possible since we can't leave Kumon-mi, so...
: I think you should do whatever you like to do. Life quickly becomes miserable once you start worrying too much about other people.
: Th-Thank you...Sensei...I...I completely agree...
: If you want...maybe we...could play together sometime?...
: Sounds good to me. What sorts of games are you into, exactly?
: Mostly RPGs...and simulation games...
: I play...um...visual novels too, but...I...prefer playing those alone, so...
: Well, we can play whatever you choose. I can't remember the last time I played anything, though, so try not to beat me too badly.
I conveniently leave out the detail where I can't remember anything else either.
: Heheh...
: I...make no promises...
Sana turns around and steps toward her bed, but I remain where I am since I can't imagine she's anything like her roommate in terms of her willingness to cozy up to an older man.

At least not yet. I have no idea how Sana will end up a little further down the line. But that line is so far away from the entrance to her dorm room that there's no point in even acknowledging it yet.
: This...isn't as scary as I thought it was going to be...
: I'll admit that...I didn't really want to let you inside, but...
: You've been really nice so far, so...thank you...
Sana begins to fiddle with a bow wrapped around the neck of an ugly stuffed animal- admitting things to it since admitting them to me would be much harder.
: There's no need to thank me. I'm sure I'll do plenty to upset or anger you in the future. It would just be rude to do that on my first trip here.
: Well...thank you so far, then...
: It might not sound like it, but...
: I...do like talking to you, Sensei...
: Or...trying to, at least...
: Don’t worry about the ‘trying’ part. Things will start coming out a lot more naturally in time.
: Just treat me like a friend until you’re more comfortable and I’m sure everything will be fine.
: R...Right...Yeah...
: Like a friend...
: I’m sorry...I’m just having...um...a hard time...thinking of you as anything more than my teacher right now, but...
: But I'm sure that...will change eventually...
: Good. Because a little piece of my heart broke off earlier when you said you didn’t even think of me as a guy.
: That!...Well!...
: I said...I'm sorry! I...don't know what else you want!
: All I want is to make you happy, Sana.
: Then...don't bring up the...weird things I say on accident!
: Say less weird things and that won't be a problem.
: I'll try...
: And...umm...I’ll...try my best to make you...a little happy too...
: As your...umm...
: As your...friend...
Feeling like that's a good place to leave things for the night, I turn around and reach for the door, only to be stopped a split second later.
: Huh?....Are you leaving already, Sensei?...
: Yeah. I think we’ve made enough progress for the day.
: You helped me kill some time and I got to see your room. Those are two solid victories.
: Hahah...If you say so...
: Will you, umm...come back soon?...
: I'd...like to maybe...do this again sometime...
: Of course.
: You can always come visit me too, you know. I'm normally in my office after school.
: I’ll...try to remember that...
: Sounds good. I’ll see you later, Sana. Thanks for letting me in.
: Yeah...
: See you later...Sensei...
I exit the room and start making my way back to the street.
I figured it would take Sana a little longer to let me inside, but I guess my initial read on her wasn't as accurate as I thought.
Either way, I’m glad she’s finally starting to warm up to me.
Here's hoping that doesn't stop anytime soon.
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]! You can now spend time with her in her room!
